Subject: Fenwick Plaza LLC - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Fenwick Plaza LLC. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need from a documentation standpoint.

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to coastal exposure considerations. Specifically, two locations fall within 16 km of the coast, and we're managing concentration in this area as our existing portfolio TIV within 25 km is already quite high.

I'll present this to the team and circle back within 2-3 business days. Given the coastal concentration challenges we're facing, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market in parallel to keep your timeline on track.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
